ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERCONSENT_CRM] AS
BEGIN
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent AS (
	SELECT 
		 BCM.ORGKEY AS [CustomerId]
		,BCM.STRTEXT13 AS [ConsentId]
		,BCM.DTDATE2 AS [PeriodStartDate]
		,'9999-12-31' AS [PeriodEndDate]
		,NULL AS [ProofOfConsentDocumentId]
		,NULL AS [CustomerConsentNote]
		,BCM.STRTEXT11 AS [NoticeTypeId]
		,BCM.STRTEXT12 AS [NoticeSharingModeId]
		,'CRM' AS [SourceCode]
		,BCM.BANK_ID AS [FinancialInstitutionId]
		,0 AS [WorkFlowId]
		,0 AS [TaskRunId]
		,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS [InsertDttm]
	FROM BUSC.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO BCM
	WHERE BCM.TYPE = 'PRIVACY_NOTICE'
	AND BCM.isLatest = '1'

)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_SRC AS (
	SELECT	
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			convert(varchar,CustomerId), 
			convert(varchar,ConsentId), 
			convert(varchar, NoticeTypeId),
			 convert(varchar, NoticeSharingModeId)))
			   AS HASHROW,CustomerId, ConsentId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_TGT AS (
	SELECT	
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			convert(varchar,CustomerId), 
			convert(varchar,ConsentId), 
			convert(varchar, NoticeTypeId),
			 convert(varchar, NoticeSharingModeId)))
			   AS HASHROW,CustomerId, ConsentId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode
    FROM BNKM.CustomerConsent
	WHERE SourceCode = 'CRM' AND (PeriodEndDate IS NULL OR PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31')
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_DELTA AS (
	SELECT
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
		,ISNULL(SRC.ConsentId,TGT.ConsentId) AS ConsentId
		,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,ISNULL(SRC.SourceCode,TGT.SourceCode) AS SourceCode
		,CASE
			WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_SRC	SRC
	LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_TGT	TGT
	ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
	AND	SRC.ConsentId = TGT.ConsentId
	AND	SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
	AND	SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_DELTA;


----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate =  CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(day,-1,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate)))
FROM BNKM.CustomerConsent TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  
AND DELTA.ConsentId = TGT.ConsentId  
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId  
AND DELTA.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode  
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
AND SRC.ConsentId = TGT.ConsentId 
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL OR TGT.PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31'



-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerConsent (
	[CustomerId]
	,[ConsentId]
	,[PeriodStartDate]
	,[PeriodEndDate]
	,[ProofOfConsentDocumentId]
	,[CustomerConsentNote]
	,[NoticeTypeId]
	,[NoticeSharingModeId]
	,[SourceCode]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
	SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
	,SRC.ConsentId AS ConsentId
	,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
	,SRC.PeriodEndDate AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS ProofOfConsentDocumentId
	,NULL AS CustomerConsentNote
	,SRC.NoticeTypeId AS NoticeTypeId
	,SRC.NoticeSharingModeId AS NoticeSharingModeId
	,'CRM' AS SourceCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_DELTA DELTA 
 ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
 AND DELTA.ConsentId = SRC.ConsentId
   AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
    AND DELTA.SourceCode = SRC.SourceCode
 WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');
	

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerConsent_DELTA;	
	
	
END
